name: kb-context-dsh
description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: auto-inject local kb-kit knowledge-base search hits into every user turn (plus an explicit `kb_query` model tool). Pure server-side hook — no client UI. Mirrors the kb-context-hook OpenClaw plugin, written for the DSH cordis runtime.
author: kb-kit
comment_deps: @deepseek-ai/* are host-provided shared packages kept in devDependencies (NOT dependencies) so host diagnostics that scan `dependencies` for shared packages stay quiet, while an editor still resolves their types at dev time. They are injected by the host at boot and never bundled.
